drafts.title: Typing
drafts.pitch: Silent, four panels: the user's typing dots come and go while Cursor stacks a ceiling-high answer, and what finally drops out of Null's handset is one die-sized block.
drafts.reason: The tower beside the tiny block lands, but huge-effort-for-a-tiny-message sits close to Thinking and Max Tokens, and the flickering dots take a moment to read.

drafts.title: Waffles
drafts.pitch: Silent, four panels: Dana's cat photo scrolls under the wall text, Cursor draws Waffles from memory as a boat with whiskers, and Tilde uncovers the real photo.
drafts.reason: The whiskered sailboat is funny, but it leans on the Waffles and boat canon, so a new reader can't tell why Cursor draws a boat.
